name: U-matic Professional Deck (Low Band)
description: Sony U-matic (3/4 inch) Low Band — the first cassette format used in professional broadcast. Heavy, expensive, but far superior to consumer VHS. Used in ENG (electronic news gathering) through the 1980s.
aesthetic_notes: U-matic Low Band has characteristic severe chroma noise — a coarse, grainy colour quality distinctive of 1970s–80s news footage. The large tape format creates different mechanical noise than VHS. Very characteristic 'documentary look.'
